scope: Synthetic local smoke probes; not production film acceptance
failure_history: Initial 12-case development run exposed six schema errors because an 8 GiB memory policy exceeded the canonical bounded integer schema. The policy was corrected; all final cases pass.
Peer integration review found vacuous empty-evidence admission and untyped malformed receipt handling. Both were corrected with native regression cases.
Earlier smoke evidence used generic application/json payload media types; it was preserved in session scratch and replaced here by a fresh execution with correct image/video/geometry media types.
